cause: The evaluation adapter included test-only observer.jar in snapshotBuildInputs; published plugin correctly required every otherwise-unclassified input JAR to be a declared compiler runtime artifact.
fix: Remove the test-only observer JAR from compiler build inputs; retain it in Test.classpath and independently pin its bytes in observer/native/model manifests.
manualWitnessMissingClasspath: A separate manual API probe without optional directory watches; not the automatic collector root cause.
